messages:
anita: Quick sync — trying to finalize customer-visible audit event names + how RBAC labels map. Need a small stable vocab, clear actor/resource fields, and KMS metadata for key-related events. Proposed examples below. Thoughts? @raj @claire

raj: +1 on stable verbs. One question: do we standardize on dot.delimited or snake_case for event names? Dots are easier to group in SIEM.

mike: also +1 on exposure flag. We should have explicit visibility: customer_visible | internal | pii_restricted. Otherwise it's easy to accidentally surface things.

claire: From product: customers expect readable labels. Please avoid internal jargon in UI strings. Keep machine names structured but provide a separate display label for docs/UI.

anita: example payload (machine-facing event_name + metadata):
```json
{
  "event": "kms.key.rotate",
  "actor": {"type": "service", "id": "svc-keymgr"},
  "resource": "kms/key/rdw-prod-enc",
  "visibility": "customer_visible",
  "outcome": "success",
  "key_version": "v3"
}
```

raj: For RBAC changes I propose events like: `rbac.binding.add`, `rbac.binding.remove`, `rbac.role.create`. We should include the subject (user/service) and the grant scope (org/team/resource).

mike: KMS-specific: include `key_material_origin` (kms|hsm|external), `algorithm`, and `key_id`. Avoid any raw key material or fingerprints in logs. If we need a fingerprint, it should be hashed with a salt and documented.

claire: Product asks that any event marked customer_visible have an example payload and a user-friendly title (`ui_label`). We should also provide a short description and recommended retention in docs.

anita: proposal: keep `event_name` machine-only (dot.delimited.lower). Add `ui_label` and `ui_description` for product. Add `owner_team` as metadata so changes have a reviewer. Also suggest a deprecation/aliasing strategy for renames (3mo compatibility + alias mapping).

raj: dot.delimited sounds good. Also recommend `actor.type` enum: human | service | system | third_party. That will help filters.

ops-oncall-bot: deploy: infra/deploy/2026-06-01 15:22 UTC — tag: release/eng-security-audit-naming

mike: Edge case: automated rollback events — we should default those to `internal` unless explicitly approved for customer visibility.

claire: Agree. Also want a lightweight review step: any new customer_visible event needs sign-off from Product + Security + the owning team. We'll add this to the RFC checklist.

anita: Action items: 1) finalize enum lists (actor.type, visibility, outcome) 2) Raj to draft RBAC event-to-resource mapping table 3) KMS (Sofia) to confirm required fields (key_id, algorithm, origin) 4) Product to supply ui_label/ui_description examples and docs mapping 5) Define rename/deprecation window and alias behavior. I'll draft an RFC and ping all owners.

raj: I'll add the RBAC mapping table to the draft and assign myself for follow-up by EOD.

mike: Pinged @sofia for KMS field specifics (will add to the RFC once confirmed).

sofia: noted — prefer `key_id`, `algorithm`, and `origin`. We'll avoid storing any KMS fingerprints in plaintext. For audit, we can include `key_version` and `rotation_reason` fields.

claire: Product will prepare sample UI pages + changelog text for customers. We'll flag any breaking renames in advance.

anita: Thanks all — I'll post the RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
